MILAAN · YOUR RECORDS

Privacy

Milaan helps you compare your seller-assigned Order number, payment screenshot Transaction ID and receiving statement. This page explains how the source code handles your records; it does not make promises about unaudited hosting or third-party backup settings.

Draft policy — important missing details: [LEGAL ENTITY], [SUPPORT EMAIL], [EFFECTIVE DATE], [HOSTING AND DATA-LOCATION DETAILS], [BACKUP RETENTION], [DATA-REQUEST PROCESS]. These must be completed and legally reviewed before publishing a final policy.

What you provide

When you save your own batches, Milaan handles your order numbers, customer names, amounts, account details, statement rows, payment screenshots, Transaction IDs, decisions and review reasons. Your account includes an email address, display name and a protected password hash. Your audit reasons may include information you typed about payments.

Seven-day expiry

Each new batch normally expires after 168 hours (seven days). Expired batches are denied access immediately. The running cleanup worker attempts deletion approximately once a minute; when the server is not running, file removal may be delayed. When the worker processes expiry or you delete a batch, Milaan removes its orders, statements, receipts, jobs, results, allocations and batch audit records, and deletes the private receipt files. Your account and seller profile/content remain. Resetting a batch clears results and allocations but keeps its inputs and earlier history until deletion or expiry. Export anything you want to retain before expiry. [CONFIRM PROVIDER BACKUP AND OBJECT-VERSION RETENTION].

Private payment screenshots

Uploaded receipts are decoded, resized and saved as private JPEGs without their original EXIF metadata. They are accessed through authenticated, seller-owned file routes rather than public image links. Deletion and orphan cleanup use background processing. No technology makes every access or deletion instantaneous. [CONFIRM HOSTED STORAGE ACCESS AND OPERATOR ACCESS POLICIES].

Gemini only when you choose it

You can manually enter or correct receipt details without cloud AI. If you explicitly request Gemini receipt reading and consent to cloud processing, the receipt image is sent to Google's Gemini service to extract suggested fields. Gemini may make mistakes. You must check the Transaction ID, amount, time and status against the original screenshot and your statement. [ADD APPLICABLE GOOGLE PROCESSING TERMS AND RETENTION DETAILS].

Browser-local mode and OCR

The fictional demo operates separately from saved backend records. Browser-local OCR may download an external OCR engine into the browser when you choose the OCR feature. It does not prove payment and must not be confused with saved server-side extraction. [IDENTIFY THE SPECIFIC OCR PROVIDER, DOWNLOAD URL AND ITS PRIVACY TERMS AFTER VERIFICATION].

Authentication emails through Resend

Milaan uses the Resend HTTPS API for account verification and password recovery emails only. Resend processes your recipient email and the authentication message, including a one-time code or recovery link. Milaan does not send your orders, payment screenshots or financial statements in these emails. [CONFIRM RESEND TRACKING, SUPPRESSION AND PROVIDER RETENTION SETTINGS].

Access and safety

Saved receipt access requires authentication and account ownership. Passwords are stored as hashes, sessions expire and can be revoked, and cookie sessions use CSRF protection. These measures help protect accounts but cannot guarantee perfect security. Please avoid uploading unrelated sensitive documents. Do not place credentials or personal financial data in public GitHub issues.

Your questions

To ask about your data, a deletion request or corrections, contact [SUPPORT EMAIL]. [SPECIFY REQUEST VALIDATION, RESPONSE PERIOD AND APPLICABLE RIGHTS].
